[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
George Glasgow is named as father of Jean (Joan) Glasgow, baptised at Stevenston, Ayrshire, on 19 July 1702; her mother is indexed as Jean Smith.<ref name="anc19703841">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60143/records/19703841 Ancestry, Scotland, Select Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950, Jean Glasgow, 19 Jul 1702, Stevenston, Ayr, Scotland]. Ancestry index transcript inspected 2026-11-05; original register uninspected.</ref><ref name="anc19703839">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60143/records/19703839 Ancestry, Scotland, Select Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950, George Glasgow (father entry), 19 Jul 1702, Stevenston]. Ancestry index entry read 2026-11-05; original uninspected.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
Identity review, 2026-11-05: this is the George Glasgow of the WikiTree profile Glasgow-4171 (father of Joan Glasgow-4105, husband of Joan Smith, Smith-407061; WikiTree estimates his birth at 1683 at Stevenston), which is not yet in the local catalogue export. Glasgow-2714 (George Glasgow, born before 1658, husband of Jean Gardiner) is not this father: the baptism names the mother Jean Smith. He was born by about 1689 (a father in 1702). His own parentage is not yet researched.

Next research: Inspect the Stevenston register entry and seek George's marriage to Jean Smith and other children.
